# Amal Anilkumar — Software Engineer

## Who is Amal Anilkumar?

Amal Anilkumar is a full-stack software engineer based in India, passionate about building scalable
web products where technology and nature thrive together. He specialises in designing and shipping
complete digital systems — from API design and database architecture to polished, production-ready
frontends.

## Core Expertise

- **Full-stack development**: Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG), NestJS, TypeScript, React 19
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (Prisma ORM), Redis, SQLite
- **API design**: RESTful APIs, JWT authentication, role-based access control
- **DevOps**: Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Vercel, Railway
- **UI/UX**: Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, glassmorphism design systems
- **CMS / Admin**: Custom admin panels, headless CMS integrations

## Services

Amal offers the following professional services:

1. **Full-stack web application development** — End-to-end product build from database to UI
2. **Admin panel & dashboard development** — Custom back-office tools with role-based access
3. **API design & backend engineering** — RESTful and event-driven APIs at scale
4. **Portfolio & personal branding sites** — Developer portfolios, agency sites, landing pages
5. **Technical consulting** — Architecture reviews, code audits, technology selection
